notes: Setup installed to two harnesses with --copy (two physical folders). remove is called with the exact positional-name argv ops_remove.rs builds; it removes the whole deployment - matching RemoveRequest's own lack of a harness field, so this is not a divergence. Every file body under a skills/<name>/ folder fetched from a remote source (including LICENSE.txt, when present) is stored on disk as a one-line stub (`stub sha256=<original hash> bytes=<n>`), never the real third-party content; tree.json still records the ORIGINAL sha256/length, and cli_parity.rs compares against that original hash, not the stub's own bytes.
